x-m-el-ai-09.title: Helidda ardayda uu qaabka saadaalinta gudbitaanka ku khaldamo

x-m-el-ai-09.material:
Waxaa jira qaab M oo saadaalinaya haddii ardaydu ka gudbaan imtixaan dugsi. Xeerka qaabka M waa “Haddii wakhtiga barashada h uu yahay 4 saacadood ama ka badan, gudub; haddii kale, kaa dhaaf.” 
 Dhab ahaan, heerka dhabta ah ee gudbitaanka imtixaankan waa “h + s÷2 ≥ 6” (s waa wakhtiga hurdada habeenkii hore), laakiin qofka dhisay qaabka tan ma yaqaan. 
 20-ka arday ee tijaabiyey qaabka dhammaantood waxay seexdeen 7 saacadood, wakhtiga barashadooduna wuxuu ahaa mid ka mid ah 1, 2, 4, ama 5 saacadood. Qaabku wuxuu sax ka helay dhammaan 20-ka arday, sax ahaan 100%.

x-m-el-ai-09.s.s1.r.b: Ballaadhinta hal dhinac oo keliya waxay ka dhigtaa shuruudaha la tijaabiyey kuwo ka sii eex badan. Ma samayn kartid isku-darrada aan tijaabada ku jirin.
x-m-el-ai-09.s.s1.o.c: Ururi arday leh isku-darrada hurdada iyo wakhtiga barashada ee aan tijaabada ku jirin
x-m-el-ai-09.s.s1.r.c: Fikirkani wuxuu isticmaalaa xaqiiqda ah in qaabku daciif noqon karo shuruudaha tijaabadu gaadhin.

x-m-el-ai-09.s.s1.r.d: Ma aadan arkin in shuruudaha ardayda tijaabada loo isticmaalay ay cidhiidhi yihiin. 100% macnaheedu waa sax kaliya shuruudahaas dhexdooda.
